entries.title: iOS 1.0.0 (202611220112) — TestFlight
entries.note: TestFlight build 202611220112 of Rome for iOS (version 1.0.0). It was archived from this commit ( 406955a ) on 2026-11-22, and App Store Connect processed it as VALID. Internal testers only. New Select part of a message's text ( #2536 ): press and hold a message, pick Select text, and the paragraph you pressed is selected in place, with the system's Copy, Look Up and Translate menu. Drag the handles to change the selection. Archived topic chats ( #2549 ): an "Archived · N" row at the end of the topic chats opens a half-height list. Swipe or press and hold a row to unarchive or delete it. An archived chat opens read only, with an Unarchive banner. Search marks archived hits. An archived topic chat can't be renamed, on iOS or the web. Instance versions Unchanged: background minimum 1.1.216, blocking minimum 1.1.196. Every API these features use is in 1.1.216.

entries.title: iOS 1.0.0 (202611202121) — TestFlight
entries.note: TestFlight build 202611202121 of Rome for iOS (version 1.0.0). It was archived from this commit ( 03346f8 ) on 2026-11-20, and App Store Connect processed it as VALID. Internal testers only. New One Tasks panel ( #2520 ): tasks are grouped as Needs you, Active, Later, Scheduled and Ended, as on the web. Press and hold a row to mark it done, stop it, pause or resume a routine, cancel a reminder or unfollow. Reply by swiping right ( #2502 ): you can reply to your own messages too, and the replied message stays in view. Pin topic chats ( #2494 ): swipe a drawer row to pin, archive or delete it. Fixes Pictures in a chat stay loaded when a long reply folds, when the app goes to the background and after a relaunch ( #2484 ). A reply's quote shows on its bubble while it is sending ( #2498 ).
